raw_response:
I farm this maize plot like my father did. I have some oxen and my family helps me plow and weed. I will put some DAP and urea because the cooperative brings it, and without it the maize does not fill the cob well on my land. I cannot afford the improved seed every year — I keep my own seed from last harvest, it grew well enough. I have no pump and no river close, so the rain is what I get. I do not buy the chemicals for spraying, I just pull the weeds with my wife and children.
